$comment: Max gzip KiB per example production bundle (ADR 0018, gyral-g1r.2). "budgets": all chunks concatenated; "initial": the entry chunk and its static imports, what a page downloads before any import() (gyral-g1r.18); "view": the view layer's client API built with the gyral-compiled condition (scripts/size/view-entry.js). Only ever lower these: pnpm size --check fails above a budget and suggests tightening when a bundle is 0.5 KiB under. Size pass (gyral-g1r.18): every budget is at most measured + 0.1 KiB; hello-world's initial budget is ADR 0018's 9.0 KiB target. The all-chunks budgets of examples that use each(), stores or forms (animated-letters, animation, autocomplete-search, devtools, http-search-github, nested-folders, no-js-first, shared-cart, typeahead-race) stay above their 0.2.0 baseline + 0.1: the lazily loaded hydration and invoker-fallback chunks (about 3.2 KiB gzip, compressed on their own) count there although client-only pages never fetch them; every initial chunk is 2.4-5.4 KiB below its 0.2.0 bundle. Template ids out of production client builds (gyral-g1r.22): every budget set to measured + 0.1 KiB, rounded to 0.1. 0.3.1 size work (gyral-c5d.2, .11-.15): defineDisposableHook (disposal tracking only when imported), spec-field features registered by the build (view transitions, frame lane, custom states), production diagnostics as codes, no property path for props in production, @gyral/time/delay; the budgets raised during 0.3.1 (autocomplete-search, view, isomorphic, no-js-first) are restored and every budget is again measured + 0.1 KiB, rounded to 0.1. "hello-world (clientOnly)" is hello-world built with gyralVitePreset({ clientOnly: true }) (view/07 "Client-only builds"; pnpm size --client-only measures every example that way). Router canonical paths and matcher parity (gyral-dyn.3, ADR 0009 addendum, 0.3.1) raised routing-view and isomorphic by 0.1 KiB. Router scroll and focus after navigation (gyral-dyn.4, ADR 0009 addendum) raised them again (routing-view +0.8 all chunks / +0.3 initial, isomorphic +0.9 / +0.4): settled() and the Navigation API intercept options in the entry, the History API path moved to a lazily loaded tier-3 chunk (ADR 0003) that now carries the scroll and focus steps. CSP-safe style attributes (gyral-dyn.5, view/08) add about 60 B gzip per example (CSSOM writes, static styles as parts, the hydration re-write in the lazy chunk), which put routing-view and isomorphic over by a few bytes once merged with the router changes; each raised by 0.1 KiB. 0.3.1-next.3 (gyral-dyn.25, .26, .27; ADR 0001 "declining parsers" addendum, view/05 "Declining", "Focus", "Prop equality"): parsers that decline let the intent walk continue outward (about 30 B gzip in every app), shadow: { delegatesFocus } is spread into attachShadow (about 10 B), and every prop carries an equals (prop.json compares the JSON; about 25 B in apps with props). Examples that went over by 4-74 B were raised by 0.1 KiB: all-chunks animated-letters, animation, bmi-nested, counter, hello-lastname, http-search-github, nested-folders, no-js-first, register, shared-cart, typeahead-race, undo-replay; initial bmi-nested, devtools, isomorphic, no-js-first, register, routing-view, typeahead-race. Trusted Types (gyral-ei9, view/01 "Instantiation"): template HTML and raw() markup are parsed through a `gyral` policy, about 60-85 B gzip in every bundle (the policy and method names and the first-use creation; creating the policy at import would save about 10 B but would throw on module load under a CSP that refuses the name); every budget it put over is raised by 0.1 KiB. 0.3.1 release-review fixes (gyral-dyn.30): Trusted Types policy creation that can't break rendering, custom states skipped on legacy Chromium, the adjacent per-event attribute fix, and (router examples) replace leaving scroll and focus alone, same-page traversals left to the browser and a full-page-load fallback when the History API chunk fails to load: +11 to +38 B gzip per example, +70 to +99 B on router examples; each budget these put over is raised by 0.1 KiB. The head model (gyral-dyn.9, ADR 0019): routing-view and isomorphic call setHead(), which bundles core's headEntries() normalizer, the router's keyed head applier and scriptSafeJson for JSON-LD (about 0.7-0.8 KiB gzip all chunks and initial, only in apps that call setHead: setHead() itself puts the applier in the router's slot), plus each example's pageHead(); their budgets are measured + 0.1 KiB. The two-call define (gyral-dyn.31, ADR 0023): `define<S, M>()(tag, spec)` adds the outer call (a small function in core plus `()` per component, +26 to +31 B minified, -1 to +19 B gzip); it put hello-world (clientOnly) (all chunks and initial) and hello-lastname (all chunks) over by a few bytes, so those budgets are raised by 0.1 KiB. Moves keep commands running and the Connected message (gyral-dyn.33, view/05 "Moves and reconnects"; about +40 B in every app) and makeHttpDriver timeoutMs (gyral-dyn.34, ADR 0022 addendum; about +0.1 KiB in apps with @gyral/http) put these examples over by a few bytes; each was raised to measured + 0.05, rounded up to 0.1. Errors through one channel (gyral-1zd.8, ADR 0024): every app now carries fail() and GyralError, the boundary ErrorEvent, transactional reducers, the init/view fallback (spec.error) and Errored dispatch, isolated hooks and store subscribers: about +0.64 to +0.79 KiB gzip per example (all chunks and initial), over the ADR's +0.2-0.3 estimate; every budget it put over is raised to measured + 0.05, rounded up to 0.1. Making spec.error and Errored spec-field features (registered only by apps naming them) could take back an estimated 0.15-0.2 KiB. Secret form fields (gyral-1zd.23, ADR 0008 addendum: password-like and listed fields never echoed in IntentRejected.values or definition.values) add 34–52 B gzip to apps that use forms only (no-js-first +47 B, register +34 B, others 0); no-js-first's initial budget rose 0.1 KiB. Automatic component loading (gyral-1zd.22, ADR 0016 addendum): register and no-js-first build with gyralVitePreset({ components: true }) and no client entry; all chunks +0.1–0.2 KiB (the loader and one chunk per component), and their `initial` now counts what a page rendering every component preloads (the loader, each component module and core's hydration chunk), which an entry build counted as lazy, so the initial budgets rise by the hydration chunk (about 2.5 KiB) without the page loading more. Child-first element hooks (gyral-1zd.27, ADR 0018 addendum "Hook order"): the hook runner (view/render/hook-run.ts: batching across a flush, children-first order, update: 'always') is installed by defineHook, so only apps with hooks pay it, about 0.3 KiB gzip; autocomplete-search, no-js-first and register (the invalid() hook) and the view entry were raised to measured + 0.05, rounded up to 0.1. Declarative subscriptions (ADR 0025, gyral-1zd.19): the five examples that now keep long-lived work in `subscriptions` (animated-letters, custom-driver, isomorphic, routing-view, seconds-elapsed) bundle the lane diff (subscriptions.ts) and `every`, about +0.3 KiB gzip each; their budgets are measured + 0.05 rounded up. Apps that don't name the field grew 18–51 B (the host's sync calls, the interpreter's cancel), within their budgets. The same change put http-search-github, register, shared-cart, typeahead-race, undo-replay over by a few bytes once merged with the 0.3.1 form and driver work (and checkbox, http-random-user, no-js-first after the tag-only intent and server-glue merges); those budgets are measured + 0.05 rounded up. Merging subscriptions with the dialog/popover bindings and call() (gyral-1zd.27) put autocomplete-search, isomorphic, no-js-first over by a few bytes; those budgets are measured + 0.05 rounded up. The essential-surface trim and the error features registered by name (gyral-1zd.24, gyral-1zd.17, 0.3.1) took about 0.1 KiB out of apps that name neither `error` nor `Errored`; the budgets that fell by 0.1 KiB or more are lowered to measured + 0.05, rounded up. Examples without a server are measured client-only (the way they ship, without the hydration chunk they never fetch; gyral-1zd.24), and the duplicate examples counter, bmi, checkbox and hello-lastname were removed (hello-world now covers text inputs and a checkbox; the create-gyral basic template is the counter); budgets for the client-only examples are measured + 0.05, rounded up. The component loader finding tags in shadow roots and offering componentsReady() (gyral-1zd.29) adds about 0.15–0.2 KiB gzip to automatic-components builds only (register, no-js-first): both budgets set to measured + 0.05, rounded up. Optional and catch-all route grammar (gyral-1zd.10, ADR 0009): isomorphic +440 B gzip (+426 B initial), routing-view +453 B (+451 B initial) against 90e7075. These two budgets are measured +0.05 KiB, rounded up to 0.1; non-router budgets stay unchanged. Core as an exact-version peer (gyral-337.5, ADR 0033, 0.3.8): each Gyral package an app loads calls requireCore(name, VERSION) from its core.ts, which warns in production when core is another release (G0016): +39 to +44 B gzip with one package (custom-driver, http-random-user, seconds-elapsed, autocomplete-search, http-search-github, workload-lab), +62/+63 B (routing-view) and +74/+67 B (isomorphic) with several; apps that load no package unchanged. The budgets it put over are measured + 0.05, rounded up to 0.1: all chunks custom-driver, http-random-user, isomorphic, seconds-elapsed; initial custom-driver, http-random-user, isomorphic, routing-view, seconds-elapsed. Listed per feature in ADR 0015's 0.3.8 addendum for the owner's approval before release. Typed driver provision (gyral-337.2, ADR 0006 addendum): driver lists through one shared lookup (driverNamed) and token.provide(): -20 to +40 B gzip per example (several shrink: the shared lookup replaces inline record reads); it put animated-letters (+14 B, all chunks and initial) and register (+14 B, all chunks) over by a few bytes, raised to measured + 0.05, rounded up to 0.1. In ADR 0015's 0.3.8 addendum for the owner's approval. Render skipping (gyral-337.1, ADR 0018 addendum): a host compares what its view reads (state, declared props, declared stores) before rendering, +104 to +148 B gzip in every app (viewInputs, sameInputs, the element's check; development's re-check stays out of production, guarded inside recheckView because Rolldown keeps cross-chunk exports); each()'s { pick, equals } adds about +30 B to apps with each, subscription delivery (select, equals, coalesce) about +140 B to apps with subscriptions (workload-lab +277 B). Budgets it put over are measured + 0.05, rounded up to 0.1. In ADR 0015's 0.3.8 addendum for the owner's approval. on() (gyral-337.6, ADR 0001 addendum): a module of its own, about +430 B gzip in apps that call it (the event check, key filter and the control, form, modifiers, files, valueAsNumber and origin fields); bmi-nested and undo-replay use it since 0.3.8 (+439 B, +441 B), their budgets measured + 0.05, rounded up to 0.1. In ADR 0015's 0.3.8 addendum for the owner's approval.
